risk_tiers.HIGH: Acts before officials on the company's behalf or foreign intermediary; enhanced review, references, outside counsel where foreign; GC and CEO approval
risk_tiers.MEDIUM: Indirect or routine government touchpoint; questionnaire, screening, clause review, certification; GC approval

rules: No engagement, agreement or vendor activation before due diligence is completed and the engagement approved
No success or contingency fees for government-facing work unless approved in writing by the General Counsel and written into the agreement
Quarterly payment monitoring of MEDIUM and HIGH third parties
detail.title: Anti-Corruption Policy and Third-Party Due Diligence Procedure
